name: Russian (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Russian offered by the Department of Slavic Languages and Literatures. A certificate adviser, typically the DUS, advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on student transcripts.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
L5 content courses should be taken only after completing RUSS 1510 (Third-Year Russian II)
With adviser approval, one advanced non-L5 course conducted in Russian (e.g., independent study graded pass/fail, graduate seminar, or advanced seminar) may count
One LxC course taught in English may count if it includes a weekly discussion section conducted entirely in Russian (minimum three students; course designated LxC)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Russian may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L4 level in Russian. At least two must be Yale courses designated L5.
